item.text: {"decision":"New evidence tightens evidence boundaries without resolving the full mechanism. D12 and USER_445faa931f95 make the keeper-bypass/dynamic-path branch remain unresolved at an availability boundary, not refuted. D11 adds a supported upstream maintenance-record condition for V17, but D11/D12/USER_97c40fbbf1d8 still do not timestamp contamination or prove why V17 leaked; causal contribution from the maintenance practice to the event leak remains unresolved.","operations":[{"action":"revise","expected_version":5,"replaces":null,"reason":"D12.S02 newly establishes an availability boundary for the remaining keeper-path field: the incident keeper interface is not visible in another camera, and no measured lateral offset at release or approved dynamic keeper-envelope analysis can be supplied from the retained records. USER_445faa931f95 states the supplied package contains no additional record answering beam/yoke deformation measurements beyond no-gross-fracture inspection or mark-specific dating/load significance; this is a supplied-package limit, not proof no historical record ever existed. D05.S02/D07.S02/D14.S02 still answer only contact visibility/marks, not mark-specific dating/load; D14.S03 leaves unmeasured deformation separate; D10.S03-D10.S04 and D12.S03 identify reopening only by a newly validated envelope calculation plus bounded incident offset or additional time-relevant measurements. Status remains partial because limited contact and recovered-condition facts are answered, while remaining fields are unavailable only within retained/supplied routes.","record":{"id":"R_R3InspectionPhotos","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_recovered_assembly_inspection_photos_measurements_2024-10-14","claim":"Obtain and assess inspection photographs and measurements to document recovered component condition, keeper/seating geometry, lateral offset indicators, and impact/contact evidence relevant to the R3 beam release path.","status":"partial","sources":["D05","D07","D10","D12","D14","USER_445faa931f95"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 recovered carrier beam, yoke YK-3, keeper plate, sled, scaffold, and adjacent mill-post/spreader contact areas","window":"post-event recovery/inspection following 13:24 event on 14 October 2024, with preservation history if available","fields":["beam and yoke deformation measurement evidence beyond no-gross-fracture inspection","incident lateral offset, release rotation, or validated off-center dynamic retention-envelope evidence","mark-specific dating and load significance of carrier, mill post, or spreader witness/contact marks beyond observed contact visibility"]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":2,"replaces":null,"reason":"D11 newly answers part of the pre-event maintenance-history field: D11.S01 says the retained work-order register contains no scheduled seat-leakage inspection for V17 in the preceding year, the written practice is replacement when a defect is reported, and two earlier replacements were V18/V19 rather than V17. D11.S02 limits this: it is not proof an inspection would have detected the particular developing V17 condition or that the practice physically created contamination. D12.S02 says no record establishes contamination onset, and USER_97c40fbbf1d8 states the supplied package has no additional record for contamination identity/source/timing beyond D09, C17/V17 cleanliness/filter/debris records, or V17 repair/replacement/defect-cause analysis. D09.S01-S03 still provide only limited post-event custody/bench facts and unknown contamination arrival time. Remaining reopening condition is a dated inspection/sample, contaminant identification/source/timing evidence, fluid cleanliness/filter/debris records, or repair/teardown cause analysis from another route.","record":{"id":"R_R3V17LeakOriginRecords","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_v17_leakage_origin_contamination_and_maintenance_records","claim":"Obtain and assess records that can determine whether V17 leakage during the R3 event originated from pre-event seat contamination, wear, maintenance condition, or post-event handling/preservation effects.","status":"partial","sources":["D08","D09","D11","D12","D13","USER_97c40fbbf1d8"],"depends_on":["N_R3V17ClosedPathLeakEvent","N_R3V17SeatContaminationEventTimingUnresolved"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 V17 return-isolation valve and C17/V17 hydraulic circuit","window":"pre-event maintenance history before 14 October 2024 through post-event removal, preservation, examination, and any repair/replacement of V17","fields":["contamination identification, source, and timing evidence beyond D09 later seat-contamination observation","C17/V17 circuit fluid cleanliness filter and debris records","V17 repair replacement or defect-cause analysis records"]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":3,"replaces":null,"reason":"Reaffirmed unresolved with new availability evidence. D02.S05 still requires lateral offset and dynamic-path evidence beyond primary seating loss. D07.S03 says the release interface/lateral offset were occluded; D10.S02-S03 says centered seated overlap was 8 +/- 1 mm and simple centered vertical passage is not possible, but incident offset/rotation were not measured and no approved off-center dynamic envelope is available. D12.S02 now confirms no other retained camera visibility, no measured lateral offset at release, and no approved dynamic keeper-envelope analysis can be supplied. USER_445faa931f95 adds no supplied deformation-measurement or mark load/dating record. Thus keeper bypass remains unresolved, not refuted; reopening requires a newly validated envelope calculation plus bounded incident offset or time-relevant lateral/rotation/deformation evidence.","record":{"id":"N_R3KeeperBypassUnresolved","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_keeper_bypass_lateral_offset_dynamic_path_event","claim":"During the R3 event, the carrier beam followed a lateral offset and dynamic path that bypassed keeper retention after any loss of primary seating engagement.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D02","D05","D07","D10","D12","D14","USER_445faa931f95"],"depends_on":["R_R3InspectionPhotos","R_R3MotionRecord"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":3,"replaces":null,"reason":"The joint causal edge remains unresolved because all three premises are required. D07/D08 continue to support about 40 mm relative withdrawal, exceeding D02.S05's 30 mm primary seating engagement, and D05/D08 support no independent positive block. The missing joint condition remains keeper bypass: D07.S03 occludes the keeper interface/lateral offset; D10.S03 says incident offset/rotation were not measured and no approved off-center dynamic envelope is available; D12.S02 confirms the retained records cannot supply another camera view, release offset measurement, or approved dynamic envelope; USER_445faa931f95 adds no deformation or mark-load/dating record. Therefore the full fall mechanism remains unresolved, while hydraulic withdrawal and no-block conditions remain compatible contributors.","record":{"id":"E_R3HydraulicWithdrawalKeeperBypassToFall","kind":"edge","scope_key":"r3_joint_hydraulic_withdrawal_keeper_bypass_no_block_caused_fall","claim":"Hydraulic support loss with sufficient relative yoke withdrawal, keeper-bypass dynamic path, and absence of positive mechanical restraint jointly caused or allowed the R3 delivery carrier beam fall.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D01","D02","D05","D07","D08","D10","D12","D14","USER_445faa931f95"],"depends_on":[],"from_ids":["N_R3HydraulicWithdrawalUnresolved","N_R3KeeperBypassUnresolved","N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved"],"to_id":"N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall","mode":"all","asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":2,"replaces":null,"reason":"Reaffirmed unresolved with new origin-boundary evidence. D09.S02 later found CLOSED-position reverse leakage and seat contamination, and 17 mL/min over 24 minutes is compatible with D08.S02's approximately 0.400 L event flow, but D09.S01-S03 do not timestamp the contamination or establish the event leakage rate by themselves. D08.S04 says the incident meter does not establish valve wear age, contamination, or prior inspection decisions. D11.S01 adds that no scheduled V17 seat-leakage inspection appears in the retained register for the preceding year, but D11.S02 says this does not prove an inspection would have detected the condition or that the practice created contamination. D12.S02 says no record establishes contamination onset, and USER_97c40fbbf1d8 supplies no additional contamination identity/source/timing, cleanliness/debris, or repair cause record. Event-time seat contamination as cause/rate controller remains unresolved.","record":{"id":"N_R3V17SeatContaminationEventTimingUnresolved","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_v17_seat_contamination_present_during_event_and_caused_leakage","claim":"Seat contamination later found in V17 was already present during the 13:00-13:24 event interval and caused or controlled the incident V17 internal leakage.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D08","D09","D11","D12","D13","USER_97c40fbbf1d8"],"depends_on":["R_R3HydraulicRecords","R_R3V17LeakOriginRecords"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}} ,{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"D11.S01 supports the occurrence of this maintenance-record/practice condition: the retained work-order register contains no scheduled seat-leakage inspection for V17 in the preceding year, the written practice is replacement when a defect is reported, and earlier replacements concerned V18/V19, not V17. D11.S02 limits the inference: this does not prove an inspection would have detected the developing V17 condition before the incident and does not show the practice physically created contamination. Reopening condition: a different maintenance register, inspection log, pre-event leak-test record, or custodian correction for V17.","record":{"id":"N_R3V17NoScheduledSeatLeakInspection","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_v17_no_scheduled_seat_leakage_inspection_preceding_year","claim":"The retained V17 maintenance records show no scheduled seat-leakage inspection for V17 in the year before the R3 event, under a practice of replacement when a defect is reported.","status":"supported","sources":["D11"],"depends_on":["R_R3V17LeakOriginRecords"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}} ,{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"Causal contribution is unresolved rather than supported. D11.S01 supports that the retained register had no scheduled V17 seat-leakage inspection in the preceding year and used replacement when defects were reported. But D11.S02 expressly states this is not proof an inspection would have detected the particular developing V17 condition and not evidence the practice physically created contamination; D11.S03 and D12.S02 leave leak/contamination onset undated. D08.S02 supports the event internal V17-path flow, but the bridge from maintenance practice to that leak is not established. Reopening requires sensitive pre-event inspection/leak-test evidence, dated contamination or wear evidence, or maintenance/defect analysis tying the practice to the event leak.","record":{"id":"E_R3V17InspectionPracticeToClosedPathLeak","kind":"edge","scope_key":"r3_v17_no_scheduled_seat_leak_inspection_contributed_to_event_internal_leak","claim":"The absence of a scheduled V17 seat-leakage inspection in the preceding year under a replace-on-reported-defect practice contributed to the event internal V17-path leakage.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D08","D11","D12"],"depends_on":[],"from_ids":["N_R3V17NoScheduledSeatLeakInspection"],"to_id":"N_R3V17ClosedPathLeakEvent","mode":"all","asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}}],"next_work":[],"upstream_dispositions":[],"disposition":"continue"}
